dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)><$cdef(27)>Arcanine</color>! I challenge you to a race!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)><$cdef(27)>Arcanine</color>Desafio-te para uma corrida!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>You’re really pumped up about racing me, huh? Sure, I can
play with ya for a li’l bit!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Você está realmente animado sobre corrida me, hein? Claro, eu posso
jogar com você para um pouco li’l!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Yesss! I’ll do my best! So... How do you think I could win?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Simss! Eu vou fazer o meu melhor! Então... Como você acha que eu poderia ganhar?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hahaha! You’re askin’ ME how to beat me?
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,21)>I’ll just say this—make sure you warm up well so you don’t
hurt yourself.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hahaha! Você está me perguntando como me vencer?
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,21)>Eu só vou dizer isso - certifique-se de se aquecer bem para que você não
Magoaste-te.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Sure thing!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Claro!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Wow, you’re really takin’ this seriously, huh?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Wow, você está realmente levando isso a sério, hein?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,7)>YAHHH!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,7)>YAHHH!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,7)>YEEEAAART!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,7)>Yaeeaart!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>You might wanna stop there... <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>You’re gonna wear yourself
out before we even start!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>É melhor parares por aí... <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>Você vai vestir-se
Saiam antes de começarmos!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>*pant pant* *gasp* I...think I’m done...warming up...
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)>Hey...I’m exhausted. Is it OK if we race another time?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>Eu... acho que acabei... de aquecer...
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)>Hey...Estou exausto. Está tudo bem se corrermos outra hora?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Wow, uh... Maybe next time don’t warm up so much?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Talvez da próxima vez não se aqueça tanto?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey <$cdef(27)>Graveler, I’ve got a question. <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>You know if there are
any good boulders around here?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Graveler, Eu tenho uma pergunta. <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>sabe se há
Alguma pedra boa por aqui?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Um...a “good” boulder? What makes a boulder...good?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Um... uma pedra “bom”? O que faz uma pedra...bom?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,8)>It’s gotta be heavy enough that I can just baaarely lift it...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,8)>Tem que ser pesado o suficiente para que eu possa apenas baaarely levantá-lo...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Ohhh, I see. So about as heavy as me?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Estou a ver, é tão pesado como eu?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)>Yeah, <$cdef(27)>Graveler, and about your size. And it should also
be round...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)>Sim. <$cdef(27)>Graveler, e sobre o seu tamanho. E também deve
Sejam redondos...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>That sounds kinda like...uh, me.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>Parece-me um pouco... eu.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,15)><$voicel(1,10)>Whoa! You’re right!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I guess the best boulder around is you, <$cdef(27)>Graveler!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,15)><$voicel(1,10)>Você está certo!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Acho que a melhor pedra é você. <$cdef(27)>Graveler!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Hee hee. I don’t really get it, but that makes me happy. ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Hee hee. Eu realmente não entendo, mas isso me faz feliz.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>I was doing reps a bit ago with a boulder about your size.
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>But I had to give up at 9,999...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Next time, I wanna see if I can hit 10,000! You in?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>Estava a fazer representantes há pouco com uma pedra do teu tamanho.
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>Mas tive de desistir às 9.999...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Da próxima vez, quero ver se consigo 10 mil!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,18)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Uh... I think I’ll pass.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,18)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Acho que vou passar.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,21)>How d’ya like THIS?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,21)>Como você gosta deste?!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Dang, bro! Check you out! Your muscles are so huge I can
barely see around ’em!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Olha para ti, os teus músculos são tão grandes que eu consigo.
mal os vemos!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>OK! Your turn, bud!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>É a tua vez, amigo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)>Aw yeah! Whaddaya think of...<wait(0.8)><$motion(1,816)>THIS?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)>O que é que te parece?<wait(0.8)><$motion(1,816)>Isto?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)>Niiice! ♪ Lookin’ real cut, bud! Your biceps look like a
couple of <$cdef(27)>Geodude!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)>Niiice! ♪ Olhando’ corte real, amigo! Seus bíceps parecem um
par de <$cdef(27)>Geodude!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Whoa, thanks! But I’m not done yet! <$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>HAH! YAH!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Gotta say, I love flexin’ with you, <$cdef(27)>Machamp! It gets me
even more pumped than usual!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Whoa, obrigado! Mas eu ainda não terminei! <$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>Sim!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Tenho que dizer, eu amo flexin’ com você, <$cdef(27)>MachampApanha-me.
ainda mais bombeado do que o habitual!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)>I feel ya on that! It’s like your muscles are more excited to
show off if they’ve got an audience!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>How ’bout the two of us aim to become the muscliest
duo out there?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)>Eu sinto você sobre isso! É como se seus músculos estão mais animados para
mostrar se eles têm uma audiência!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>Que tal nós dois nos tornarmos o muscliest
A dupla está lá fora? !

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Aw yeah, count me in! With our muscles combined,
nothing can stop us! HAH! YAH! MUSCLE!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Sim, conta comigo, com os nossos músculos combinados,
Nada nos pode parar!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)><$textsize(2)>MUSCLE!!!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)><$textsize(2)>MÚSCULO!!!</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$motion(2,17)><$voicel(2,3)>Om nom...<wait(0.4)> <$motion(2,19)>*gulp* Oop...one down...
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,17)><$voicel(2,3)>Om nom...<wait(0.4)> <$motion(2,19)>Oop... um para baixo...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>One down?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Um já foi?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,1)>Umm... My berries. Now I’m down one.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,1)>Umm... minhas bagas. Agora eu estou abaixo de um.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,6)>Huh? Your berries? I don’t see any berries...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,6)>Huh? Suas bagas? Eu não vejo nenhuma bagas...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, I’ve got six berries stored in my cheeks right now...
<$motion(2,19)><$voicel(2,6)>*GULP*
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Aaack! Now I’m down to five!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Bem, eu tenho seis bagas armazenadas em minhas bochechas agora...
<$motion(2,19)><$voicel(2,6)>GULP
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Aaack! Agora eu estou para baixo para cinco!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>Wha—? You’ve still got five whole berries in your cheeks?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>O que -? Você ainda tem cinco bagas inteiras em suas bochechas?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Now I’ve ONLY got five berries left! Gosh, what am I
gonna do now?!
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmmm... Y’know, you’re starting to look awfully berry-like.
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>I wonder if I could fit YOU in my cheeks.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Agora eu só tenho cinco bagas sobrando!
vai fazer agora?!
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmmm... Você sabe, você está começando a olhar terrivelmente como a fruta.
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Será que consigo caber-te nas minhas bochechas?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, uh...I-I tell you what—how about I go and find some
berries for you?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Vou dizer-te uma coisa, que tal eu ir e encontrar um pouco de...
Bagas para ti?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>You’re looking tough and sturdy as always, <$cdef(27)><$cname(64)>.<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)> One
day I’d like to battle to see who has a tougher body.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Você está olhando duro e resistente como sempre, <$cdef(27)><$cname(64)>.<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)> Uma.
dia eu gostaria de lutar para ver quem tem um corpo mais duro.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Awww, that’s so sweet of you to say!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>To be honest, though, these days I’m rather jealous of
<$voicel(1,5)>softer bodies—like <$cdef(27)>’s!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Awww, isso é tão doce de você dizer!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Para ser honesto, porém, hoje em dia eu tenho bastante inveja de
<$voicel(1,5)>corpos mais suaves—como <$cdef(27)>De!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>Hm? How come...?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>Porque é que...?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, <$cdef(27)> works so hard to make all
sorts
of
nice
things
for
us,
right?
<$voicel(1,4)>If I accidentally bump into things with this hard body of
mine, <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,1)>I’m bound to break something sooner or later!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>I’d feel so much more at ease if I were softer.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, <$cdef(27)> trabalha tão duro para fazer todos
sorts
de
bom.
coisas
em vez
nós,
Certo?
<$voicel(1,4)>Se eu acidentalmente esbarrar em coisas com este corpo duro de
meu, <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,1)>Mais cedo ou mais tarde vou quebrar alguma coisa!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu me sentiria muito mais à vontade se fosse mais suave.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)><$facial(1,2)>You’re so mature, <$cdef(27)><$cname(64)>...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>I still get the urge to just launch myself <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>right into stuff
sometimes... <$voicel(2,1)>What should I do?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)><$facial(1,2)>Você é tão maduro, <$cdef(27)><$cname(64)>...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Ainda tenho vontade de me lançar sozinho. <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>para dentro das coisas.
Às vezes... <$voicel(2,1)>O que devo fazer?

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, whenever that happens, dear, don’t hesitate to crash
right into ME as hard as you can!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll stop you right in your tracks!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, sempre que isso acontecer, querida, não hesite em bater
directamente para mim o mais forte que puderes!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu vou pará-lo em seus rastros!

dialogues.en: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Th-thank you! I can always rely on you...
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Obrigado, posso sempre confiar em ti.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>And then... And then... Uh...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>E depois... e depois...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Wow, sounds like you were up pretty late...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Parece que acordaste muito tarde...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Yeah! I was having so much fun!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Ah...ah...<$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,5)><$facial(0,13)>achoo!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Estava a divertir-me tanto!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Ah... ah...<$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,5)><$facial(0,13)>Achoo!

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>You should warm up and get a good night’s sleep today.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Gotta get rid of that cold quickly. <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>If you set fire to a house
<$cdef(27)> built, that would be really bad...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Você deve se aquecer e dormir bem hoje.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Tenho de me livrar dessa constipação rapidamente. <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Se incendias uma casa
<$cdef(27)> Construído, isso seria muito mau...

dialogues.en: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>I’m already warm all the time...but I’ll be extra careful!
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Eu já estou quente o tempo todo... mas eu vou ser extra cuidado!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,814)>Achoo!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,814)>Achoo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,54)>Brr!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,54)>Brr!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, sorry about that... I must’ve given you chills...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, desculpe por isso... Devo ter lhe dado calafrios...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>I’m t-t-totally fine! Y’know, despite how I look, I actually
prefer the cold!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Eu estou t-t-totalmente bem! Você sabe, apesar de como eu olhar, eu realmente
Prefiro o frio!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)>Oh, really? I’m a little surprised...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)>É mesmo? Estou um pouco surpreso...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Anyways, it looks to me like you’ve got a cold, <$cdef(27)>Glaceon!
Totally a cold, right?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,801)>Hang around with me and you’ll get super nice ’n’ warm
and be back on your feet in no time...probably!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>De qualquer forma, parece-me que você está constipado, <$cdef(27)>Glaceon!
Totalmente constipado, certo?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,801)>Ficar comigo e você vai ficar super bom 'n' quente
e estar de pé em pouco tempo... provavelmente!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,16)>Huh...? I just got a little dust up my nose.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,806)>Besides, I prefer the cold too...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,16)>Só tenho um pouco de pó no nariz.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,806)>Além disso, também prefiro o frio...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,5)>OHMYGOSH!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motionoff(1,802)>C-could it be that it’s a total pain to be around me?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,5)>Oh, meu Deus!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motionoff(1,802)>C-poderia ser que é uma dor total estar perto de mim?!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, um... I think I’m feeling a bit too chilly today. Maybe
we could talk just a bit more?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Acho que estou com frio demais hoje.
Podemos falar um pouco mais?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>YEAHHH! So—what do you wanna talk about?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Então, sobre o que quer falar?

dialogues.en:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>. Great timing.
<$lookat(2,0,1)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)><$voicel(2,6)>Let’s have <$cdef(27)> decide for us.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Grande momento.
<$lookat(2,0,1)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)><$voicel(2,6)>Vamos ter <$cdef(27)> Decide por nós.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,20)>Yeah, let’s!<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>OK, <$cdef(27)>. Between me and Raboot...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>WHO
HAS
LONGER EARS?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,20)>Sim, vamos!<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>Está bem. <$cdef(27)>Entre mim e o Raboot...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>QUEM
HAS
Orelhudos?!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Ehehehe! Yesss! I knew it! Just look how tall these bad
boys stand up!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Sim, sim, sim, eu sabia, mas olha como estas coisas são altas.
Rapazes, levantem-se!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Really? Hmmm. Ah well, doesn’t really matter.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Realmente? Hmmm. Ah bem, não importa realmente.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Clearly. Heh, good to know you’re paying attention.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Claramente. Heh, bom saber que você está prestando atenção.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)>Nooo! Ugh, maybe if I massage my ears, it’ll make ’em
longer somehow.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)>Não! Ugh, talvez se eu massagear meus ouvidos, vai fazê-los
Mais tempo de alguma forma.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hmm? You wanna know why we’re even talking about this?
’Cause whoever has longer ears is obviously cooler, DUH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>quer saber porque estamos a falar disto?
Porque quem tem ouvidos mais longos é obviamente mais frio, DUH!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,7)>Well, I was playing along since I can kinda see what you
mean, <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>but then you started talking about how yours are
longer, and <$voicel(2,2)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>wouldn’t listen to reason...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,7)>Bem, eu estava a colaborar, já que consigo ver o que tu...
quer dizer, <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Mas depois começaste a falar sobre como são as tuas.
maior, e <$voicel(2,2)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>não escutava a razão...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Wha—?! You were saying the exact same thing earlier! I
couldn’t help hearing it with these PERFECT EARS!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>O quê?! Você estava dizendo exatamente a mesma coisa mais cedo!
Não pude deixar de ouvi-lo com estas EARS PERFECT!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>You mean perfectly short?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>quer dizer, perfeitamente curto?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,7)>Grrr! Your jabs come up short, just like your EARS!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,7)>Os teus golpes são curtos, tal como os teus EARS!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Nuh-uh! We aren’t friends at ALL! Are we, <$cdef(27)>Raboot</color>?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Nós não somos amigos em TODOS! <$cdef(27)>Raboot</color>?!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,22)>Yeah, I’m with <$cdef(27)>Flareon</color> on this one.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,22)>Sim, eu estou com <$cdef(27)>Flareon</color> Neste aqui.

dialogues.en: <$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Huh? We’re not fighting. <$cdef(27)>Flareon</color> and I are friends.
dialogues.pt_br: <$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Nós não estamos brigando. <$cdef(27)>Flareon</color> e eu sou amigo.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Oh yeah?! Well I think of you as my BEST friend, so how
about THAT?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Oh sim?! Bem eu penso em você como meu melhor amigo, então como
Sobre isso?!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hahaaa! Ya snooze, ya lose! Looks like this berry is mine!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Parece que esta fruta é minha!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Nonsense!
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>I got to the berry first and you know it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Tolice!
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>Cheguei primeiro ao baga e tu sabe disso!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Not backin’ down, I see...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I wager ya haven’t heard tell of my strength, have ya?
I’ll have you know that all Pokémon in the sky fear me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Não retrocedendo, eu vejo...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Aposto que não ouviu falar da minha força, não é?
Saiba que todo Pokémon no céu tem medo de mim!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, do they now? Well, perhaps YOU haven’t heard that
I’m feared by all Pokémon on the ground!
Feast yer eyes on my power! <$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,9)>GRRRAAAR!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, eles agora? Bem, talvez você ainda não ouviu isso
Todos os Pokémon no chão me temem!
Refresquem os vossos olhos no meu poder! <$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,9)>GRRAAAR!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, bless yer heart. Is that what you think passes fer power
these days? Check THIS out!
<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRRAHHH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>É isso que achas que passa pelo poder?
Hoje em dia?
<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRRAHH!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, well! Looks like we’re evenly matched. But what
about speed? <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I’m clearly the faster runner!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, bem! Parece que estamos em igualdade. Mas o que
Sobre velocidade? <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Eu sou claramente o corredor mais rápido!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Now, why would I ever face you in a footrace when we
both know I’m faster flyin’?!
<$voicel(1,7)>Besides, this berry is—<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>huh?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Agora, porque é que eu te enfrentaria numa corrida de pés quando nós
ambos sabem que eu sou mais rápido voar’?!
<$voicel(1,7)>Além disso, esta fruta é...<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Não é?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Huh?! Where’d it go?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Para onde foi?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>It, uh...got crushed to a pulp.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Foi... esmagado até à morte.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Whoops. Guess I got a li’l carried away...
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>I s’pose we’ll jus’ hafta put our li’l competition on hold fer
the time bein’.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Whoops. Acho que eu tenho um li'l levado longe...
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu suponho que nós vamos apenas 'hafta colocar nossa concorrência li'l em espera fer
o tempo que passa».

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Heya! Let’s practice together today!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Heya! Vamos praticar juntos hoje!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>OK!
<$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Let’s decide what we’re gonna practice by counting down
and saying our choice at the same time!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Está bem!
<$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Vamos decidir o que vamos praticar contando para baixo
e dizer a nossa escolha ao mesmo tempo!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Sure! One, two...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Um, dois...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Sing</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Cantar</color>!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Thunder Punch</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Trovão Soco</color>!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Whoops, we didn’t match.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Opa, nós não combinamos.

dialogues.en: <$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I guess that means...
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Acho que isso significa...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Yup! Forget practicing moves, and PLAY!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Esquece os movimentos de treino e joga!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>YEAH!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Sim!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Phew! That was so fun! What should we do tomorrow?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Foi tão divertido, o que devemos fazer amanhã?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Tomorrow we should REALLY get around to practicing.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Amanhã devemos realmente começar a praticar.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Definitely! Let’s decide what move we’ll practice tomorrow
by saying our choice at the same time!
<$voicel(1,8)>One, two...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Definitivamente! Vamos decidir que movimento vamos praticar amanhã
Dizendo a nossa escolha ao mesmo tempo!
<$voicel(1,8)>Um, dois...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Sing</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Cantar</color>!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Thunder Punch</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Trovão Soco</color>!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>We didn’t match again.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Nós não combinamos novamente.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,10)>Then let’s forget practice tomorrow and PLAY AGAIN!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,10)>Então vamos esquecer o treino amanhã e JOGAR DE NOVO!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>YEAH!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>Sim!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,10)><$textsize(2)>BWACHOOO!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,10)><$textsize(2)>Bwachooo!</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$se2d(2394)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,23)><$motion(2,842)><$facial(2,9)>Aah! I g-g-got z-z-z-zapped...
dialogues.pt_br: <$se2d(2394)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,23)><$motion(2,842)><$facial(2,9)>Eu tenho z-z-z-zapped...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Oops, I’m so sorry! I guess I let out some electricity when
I sneezed...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Oops, eu sinto muito! Eu acho que eu deixei para fora um pouco de eletricidade quando
Eu espirrei...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>D-don’t worry about it—I’m fine... But your electricity is
pretty powerful, isn’t it? <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>It gave me quite a shock...
dialogues.pt_br:

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>Oliolitoooooohhh...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Hold up! What’s that beautiful melody?! <wait(0.8)><$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Kriii tututu...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Espera aí! Que melodia linda é essa?! <wait(0.8)><$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Kriii tututu...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, my! ♪ <wait(0.9)><$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Ribbit... Rrrribbit ribbibbit olitooohhh! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Meu Deus! <wait(0.9)><$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Ribbit, ribbit ribbibbit olitoooohhh!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,817)>Tuuu... Tutuuune...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,817)>Tuuuuune...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Oli oh olitooohhh! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Oli oh olitooohhh!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)>Krrrrrririririii... Tutuuu krikriii...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)>Krrrrririririii Tutuu krikriii...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Rib... Olioliolioli...ribbitoh tooohhh! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Ribbitoh tooohhh!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Aw yeah, we sure made one sweet song together!
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>You make such interesting melodies!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Sim, com certeza fizemos uma canção doce juntos!
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>Fazem melodias tão interessantes!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,8)>Oh, I’m so glad you think so! It felt lovely to just go all out
singing like that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,8)>Oh, eu estou tão feliz que você pensa assim! Foi adorável para ir tudo para fora
A cantar assim!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)>That low bass sounded like it was rumbling up from the
bottom of your belly—talk about inspiration overload!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Aw yeah, I feel like I could come up with a whole bunch of
new songs! You gotta let me hear you sing more!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)>Que baixo baixo baixo soou como se ele estava estrondo acima do
fundo de sua barriga – fale sobre sobrecarga de inspiração!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Sim, sinto que podia inventar um monte de
tem de me deixar ouvir-te cantar mais!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>I’d love nothing more! Here goes! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)>Ohhh olitoh
TOOOHHH!!! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Eu adoraria nada mais! Aqui vai! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)>Ohhh olitoh
TOOOHHH!!!!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Gliiimmm. ♪ Look. <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>My physical body shines and is
beautiful, do you not think?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Olha. <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>O meu corpo físico brilha e é
Linda, não achas?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>That sure is a shiny body ya got there, I tell ya what!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)>It’s no match fer my sparkly, shiny, beautiful body, though!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Que corpo brilhante que tem aí, digo-te uma coisa!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)>Não é igual ao meu corpo brilhante, brilhante, bonito, embora!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)>You said what? Who is no match for who?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Well. I am sparkly and shiny and also glimmering! I am
the winner!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)>Quem não é páreo para quem?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Bem, eu sou brilhante e brilhante e também brilhante!
O vencedor!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Oh yeah? Well, I do declare that I am sparkly! And shiny!
And glimmerin’ and GLISTENIN’ and, uh...um...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Hey, hold up just a sec...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Bem, eu declaro que sou brilhante e brilhante!
E brilho’ e GLISTENIN’ e, uh...um...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Espera um segundo...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>What? What has happened?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>O que aconteceu?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>BEHOLD! That there shine o’ yers is reflectin’ offa my
body, makin’ me...<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>EVEN SHINIER!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>BEHOLD! Que lá brilhar o’ yers é refletido em’ offfa meu
corpo, fazendo-me...<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Até mais brilhante!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>You are correct! And that enhanced shine further reflects
off of my body—<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>making me look even more shiny as well!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Você está correto! E esse brilho melhorado reflete ainda mais
fora do meu corpo...<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>fazendo-me parecer ainda mais brilhante também!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Y’know...if we become friends, you ’n’ me, I wager the two
of us together could become downright bee-yoo-tiful!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Você sabe... se nos tornarmos amigos, você 'n' mim, eu aposto os dois
de nós juntos poderia tornar-se completamente abelhudo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Yes! We could be sparkly and shiny and glimmering and
glistening and dazzling and—
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>How beautiful could we become? It is scary to think of.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Sim! Nós poderíamos ser brilhantes e brilhantes e brilhantes e
Brilhante, deslumbrante e...
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Como poderíamos nos tornar bonitos? É assustador pensar em.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>Bleh! This dirt’s so bitter. Gross!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>Bleh! Esta sujeira é tão amarga. Nojento!

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Now you listen here, <$cdef(27)>Larvitar! You ain’t gonna grow
big ’n’ strong bein’ all picky like that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Agora, ouve-me. <$cdef(27)>LarvitarVocê não vai crescer
grande 'n' forte ser' todo exigente como aquele!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$motion(1,662)>Whatever! I don’t care—I don’t wanna get bigger anyway!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$motion(1,662)>Tanto faz! Eu não me importo – Eu não quero ficar maior de qualquer maneira!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>That right? Are ya SUUURE?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>It’d be real easy to eat more o’ them berries ya love if you
were bigger, y’know. Guess ya don’t love berries after all...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>- Está certo?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>Seria muito fácil comer mais o’ eles bagas que você ama se você
eram maiores, você sabe. Acho que você não gosta de bagas afinal de contas...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Huh? Wait...really?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Espera... a sério?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>You bet yer britches! Size is power! Why, if you were big,
all you’d need is a li’l shake of a tree and BAM! <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Tons o’
berries would fall right out! <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>You could eat, eat, EAT as
much as ya like!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>pode apostar que o tamanho é poder!
tudo o que você precisaria é um tremor de li'l de uma árvore e BAM! <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Toneladas de vinho»
As bagas caíam logo! <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Você poderia comer, comer, comer como
O quanto quiseres!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Wh-Whoa, that’s super awesome!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Does that mean you could eat up a whole MOUNTAIN
of berries, <$cdef(27)>Tyranitar?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Wh-Whoa, isso é super incrível!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Isso significa que pode comer uma montanha inteira?
de bagas, <$cdef(27)>Tyranitar?!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,4)>Hm?! M-me?! A-ain’t no doubt about it! I could eat ALL
them berries. Mm-hmm. Yep...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,4)>Hm?! M-me?! A-não há dúvida sobre isso! Eu poderia comer TODOS
As bagas.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>That rules! You’re the coolest, <$cdef(27)>Tyranitar. I’m gonna work
hard to get big like you! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>And I’ll stop being so picky.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Isso regras! Você é o mais legal, <$cdef(27)>TyranitarEu vou trabalhar
É difícil crescer como tu! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>E vou deixar de ser tão exigente.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)>Gwahaha! That’s the spirit! I believe in ya!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)>Gwahaha! Esse é o espírito! Eu acredito em você!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>Oof. I’m STARVING!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>Oof. Estou esfomeado!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>What about all this yummy food right here? Dig in!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>E toda esta comida deliciosa aqui?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Right here? Right...where?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Aqui mesmo?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Everywhere! The soil! Doesn’t it look tasty?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Em toda parte! O solo! Não parece saboroso?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>You know, dirt’s not usually considered “food.”
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Você sabe, a sujeira não é geralmente considerada “alimento”.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>What?! But it’s so tasty! Even though sometimes rocks get
mixed in there, <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>so it kinda hurts when you bite down...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>O quê?! Mas é tão saboroso! Mesmo que, às vezes, as pedras ficam
misturados ali, <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Por isso dói quando mordes...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,3)>Rocks? I woulda thought you could crunch those to bits,
no problem.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,3)>Pensei que podias fazer isso em pedaços.
Não há problema.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Of COURSE I can’t crunch ’em up! I’ll tell you what—
next time I find a rock while I’m eating, I’ll give it to you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>É claro que não consigo esmagá-los! Vou te dizer o que...
Da próxima vez que eu encontrar uma pedra enquanto eu estou comendo, Eu vou dar a você!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>No thanks. Rocks, uh, aren’t really my thing.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Não, as pedras não são a minha praia.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>*sigh*...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>*suspiro *...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Something wrong, <$cdef(27)>Lotad</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Alguma coisa errada, <$cdef(27)>Lotad</color>?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>I had a berry I was really looking forward to eating, but
then I went and dropped it...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>Comi uma baga e estava ansioso para comer, mas...
Então fui e deixei cair...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>Oh no, that’s too bad... Well, try distracting yourself with
something else.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)>How about...some exercise? You could go for a run, feel
the breeze on your face...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>Oh não, isso é muito ruim... Bem, tente se distrair com
outra coisa.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)>Que tal... algum exercício?
A brisa no teu rosto...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Uuuh... Nah, I’m OK... I’m not very good at running anyway.
My head’s too heavy...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Uuuh... Não, eu estou bem... Eu não sou muito bom em correr de qualquer maneira.
Minha cabeça está muito pesada...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Oh, er, I see... Well, how about taking a nap?
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>Maybe doing something you usually do will help.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Estou a ver... que tal uma sesta?
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>Talvez fazer algo que normalmente fazes ajude.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Yeah... Just floating along in the water, <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>relaxing and
listening to the sounds... That might help me forget...
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Why don’t you join me, <$cdef(27)>Raboot?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Sim... apenas flutuando na água, <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>relaxado e
Ouvir os sons... isso pode ajudar-me a esquecer...
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Por que você não se junta a mim, <$cdef(27)>Raboot?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,4)>Uh, me? Water? I, er...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,4)>Água?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>Don’t worry, you can ride the leaf on my head! <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>That should
make it OK, right?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>Não se preocupe, você pode montar a folha na minha cabeça! <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Isso deve ser feito.
Faz com que esteja tudo bem, certo?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>Y-yeah, that’ll be fine... <wait(1.0)>Probably?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>Sim, está tudo bem... <wait(1.0)>Provavelmente?

dialogues.en:
